doc_title_en: Announcement of Revision to Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Revision to Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase) for FY3/27
doc_title_jp: 連結業績予想の修正および配当予想の修正（増配）に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 業績上方修正と130周年記念配当

summary_en: FY3/27 full-year dividend guidance raised to ¥90/share from ¥70/share (ordinary ¥80/share + commemorative ¥10/share for 130th anniversary). Interim dividend raised to ¥45/share from ¥35/share (ordinary ¥40 + commemorative ¥5). Net earnings guidance lifted 10.8% on acquisition of wholly owned subsidiary (Shibusawa World Transport) and improved core business utilization; payout ratio floor 50%+.
summary_jp: 通期3月期配当予想を¥70→¥90/株に上方修正（普通¥80+記念¥10）。中間配当¥35→¥45/株（普通¥40+記念¥5）。完全子会社化と既存事業改善で純利益10.8%上振れ；配当性向50%以上の累進的方針。
tag_en: Dividend hike — ¥90/share (¥80 ordinary + ¥10 commemorative) FY3/27 — +¥20 vs prior guidance — 130th anniversary special
tag_jp: 増配 — ¥90/株（普通¥80+記念¥10）通期3月期 — 前回予想比+¥20 — 創業130周年記念配当
